component.name: Autodesk Fusion
component.summary: Cloud-connected 3D CAD, CAM, CAE, and PCB software

description.p: Autodesk Fusion (formerly Fusion 360) is an integrated 3D CAD, CAM, CAE, and PCB design platform. This Flatpak package runs Autodesk Fusion seamlessly on Linux using an optimized GE-Proton compatibility layer with Vulkan DXVK acceleration.

ul.li: High-performance DirectX 11 translation via Vulkan DXVK
Host browser authentication support (adsk:// and adskidmgr:// handling)

description.p: Initial standalone Flatpak package for Autodesk Fusion powered by GE-Proton 11.
